title: The Seventh of the Green

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The stall goes up and the slate comes out, and the figure goes over the basket twice. Two greens are one colour and two turnings one shape only to a man who wants them to be. The bell gives four, four and a gap, and a body under a roof keeps what the market cannot enter. Ask the pot. Ask the weather. Nobody is told what the hand was holding.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Vail kiln-house, kept over the first market of Grain

where: Low Kiln and the Cross, Sill
pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and nineteen to two hundred and twenty-one days, six months and thirty-nine days to six months and forty-one days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing (a cost asked as a direction answered with the pot and the weather, the carrying arm as a record in muscle that knows weight and not cost, a seventh green and a seventh half-turn taken apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and set on places that do not touch, the private file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing, and an inch of a small hand asked again under a roof the market cannot enter) without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no opening, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no joining of the seventh green to the seventh shape, no name spoken over either, no calling of the loan, no payer named, no private record read, no betrayal paid and no ending

scenes.title: The Hand Laid Down
scenes.synopsis: First entry, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 219, Grain 10, Tenthday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and up the clay road toward the Cross. No recap: the hand lies down against the fold after the two-rhythm letting-go of the night before and that coordination is not recalled as a sign, growth or reaching, only set down like a tool. The boy is two hundred and nineteen days old and six months and thirty-nine days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire gives four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have been, its payer unnamed for two hundred and nineteen days (T088); through a finger's-width door the river keeps its note of water over water, a fifth low thing never counted among the hearings, and overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- three counts in three places that do not become one, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that with the sour Ash breath of the unswept corner the house calls the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. One leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread of drool frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. The file is exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh, three near-full answers, three shapings of the pot saying and the fourth burned-slate telling on their own places told a fourth time, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Ember's three readings and the true subtraction in Berr's locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes on three places with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the burned-slate word with a hand between it and Jorra's dust and the two shut-room tellings; an empty place kept empty is a finding and a finding filled to make a row come out even is forged (T061/T082, T036/T076, T035/T031/T065/T095, T006). Sella comes to the fire before the basket: instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind, never the basket; the house, not I; half-pace from every open slate; glance at the clay jar cold under its glaze and hand shut half over nothing without a touch; lips along the two-gapped row with no figure; finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread; pot rim set out with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand, a half-beat longer at the setting, no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in thirty-nine days (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept in objects --- salt coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines called thaw, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt circled without a name, name unspoken for two hundred and nineteen days (T009/T013/T092). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold --- a miss with no failure hidden in it, filed on the sixth place, laid across nothing, no payer named (T061/T082). The stalls are going up at the Cross and the reading block is being made ready; Sella carries him up the clay road at the half-pace for Grain's first Account-day and market, and sets him down where no slate lies, and the boy has not yet been carried to the block (T058/T079, T077).

scenes.title: The Figure Over the Basket
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 219, no new dated heading: morning into midday and the going of the light at the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post, the pot board across the square, the market's edge, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, then home under the Vail roof and the small hours. The chapter's one true change, paid as sightings only and not as a resolution: a SEVENTH green comes to the mouth of a silent woman at the pot board --- clay under her nails in the small crescents, the pale line across the back of one hand where something was once worn tight and long, the sweetish green of lead glaze in the crease beside her lip, a cup turned a quarter without lifting and set back exactly where it stood, no word --- filed as a seventh colour and never Fenna in the narration, joined to no ear (T050/T051 paid as a colour); and a SEVENTH sighting of the foundling comes at the market's edge --- a shape in cast-offs with a man's shoulders and breeches cut off at the knee, silt dried pale in the creases of the wrists, a gap where a front tooth had been, the green sliver on its string catching the light and going dull, its head going toward a set-down pot a half-beat late and stopping in the middle --- filed as a seventh shape and never Ulda in the narration, no loaf passed, no slate near the basket, no sale, not joined to the boy's own turning and the sale to the Waiting Room clerk left years ahead (T033/T034 paid as a shape). Both are set on places that do not touch: a colour is not a hearing, a shape is not a seventh of the full note, neither is a tenth stopping, a cause, a name or a romance, and no fourth likeness stands up to call itself a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer. Berr Clay comes up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wipes his thumb twice before touching nothing, holds a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passes a finger over the figure and reads *one in twelve, as the notice says* low over the basket, the figure going twice over it, once for the moot and once for those who came late; he calls the levy, denies it with *your house*, never *I*, and goes off up the road with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he has done a kindness; a figure read aloud is still not the figure paid and the reading answers nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047/T077). The bell goes four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told (T078); Hessa Rale goes up the clay road before noon with the slate edge-on, hand to slate before eye to crowd and writing to her sleeve, a runner who carries and does not read, no figure coming off it (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stays set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, the market sold over him (T090). Sella sets the basket in the moot-post's finger's width of shade where no slate lay, keeps the half-pace from every open slate including the reading block, gives no instruction to the basket, and carries him home at the going of the light, wide around the pan's gone ring, the bare dark trough, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the field's empty place and the carriers' place, each with a look and a wide step and no number; carrying arm remembers weight and not cost; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: hand up an inch, held for the small intake only and down before the letting go --- an honest fraction shorter than the whole breath, on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Day After the Reading
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 220, Grain 11, Firstday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the wheel-shed edge and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and twenty days old and six months and forty days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and twenty days (T088); fire, river and boards keep three counts in three places (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, the market gone and the reading block left standing empty. Grain's first arithmetic has changed and cannot be changed back, but it goes unread under this roof: the printed one in twelve stands unchallenged, the figure read over the basket yesterday is still not the figure paid, Berr's box is locked up the road, Hessa's slate has gone up unread and the soft-cuffed clerk is still set for his uncalled measure, all held offstage in the boy's file and none reached back (T015/T041/T047, T077, T080, T090 held). The seventh green and the seventh shape stay a colour and a shape on places that do not touch, now a day old and gathered, with no eighth of either, no second look joined, no name spoken over either and no promotion into a hearing, a cause or a romance (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced). Cost-questions at the door and the well go to the pot and the weather and away level, nothing priced, refused or entered; a man off the clay road keeps a number shut in his fist and puts it back in his sleeve (T077). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough whose water is called weather and the field's empty place, each with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). Sella's instruction grammar, the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty days; private roll unshown and Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife at the very edge of its sill with six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping and not a new one, breath drawn at the top of the reach and not spent; nine stoppings stay nine objects with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven; the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, *Yes, house* to the early thaw and the late; the stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, and no collector comes on Grain 11; the warm stone lies cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T061/T082, T006, T062). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, white in a knuckle where a fist opened, not bone-coloured slip; dusty and clean forearms on one tray; men unnamed went low into the finger's-width-open back room before first grey and got no name, the room not called cold, the two shut-room tellings still two and the burned-slate word, told four times, still a direction arrived nowhere; he speaks to the wheel before anyone (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*), tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the full note he knows it will give three turns ahead, and holds his bent finger in the cold damper until Sella's unfinished sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition, not a change made again; the three shapings of the pot saying stay sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no pot lost, and no name is given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name is neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T061/T082). Morning hand: up an inch, down before the counted breath has finished --- an honest miss filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Tending Kept
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 220, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending, heat going off the high air first and settling under the shelf, behind the pot and into the fold where one stiff leathery brown-edged crust keeps its empty place unnamed and no third comes; the thread is frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a row with two unnamed gaps and gives nobody a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said *The house will keep it*, stood with the back of the pot counting under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim out with handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and did not look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched at an afternoon and a dusk, no opening in forty days, because a shelf, an afternoon and a bed are not openings (T058/T079, T100). Garl kept to the day without a story: salt-stiff coat with the crease at the left shoulder, twenty-year hollow and leftward lean of the seat, clean dark line and finer hairline called the thaw unswept, the proverb gone to a pot with no crack, the tile debt circled without a name and worse for being uncalled; no lesson, no collector, name unspoken for two hundred and twenty days (T009/T013/T092). The seventh colour and the seventh shape stay gathered and unjoined, and the burned-slate word stays a fourth direction arrived nowhere (T050/T051, T033/T034, T035/T031). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count* with the knife at the lip and Garl's unforged sentence beside it; the ear-sentence stops short of the calling word as a remembered stopping; nine stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; Seed 16 unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 11; he sweeps past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn; stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra with the day's meal-fine dust, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, pot told *You'll do*, all three sayings about the pot left standing as sayings with no lesson and no pot lost, no name for what ailed the carried man; bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot; burned slate a direction, shut-room tellings still two, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars, river wind behind with the taste of water over water, wide around each absence with a look and no number; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: with no breathing number anywhere in the house, hand up an inch and kept to the river's own low interval --- the draw, the slack, the small pause, down on the next low note --- the one-rhythm coordination remembered, not a change made again, filed on the sixth place and laid across nothing; no payer named (T061/T082). Two hundred and twenty exact and unspent; fire in the room that warms him, river in the room he cannot enter, neither stopping for the ear.

scenes.title: The Ordinary Second Day
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 221, Grain 12, Secondday, small hours under the Vail roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the Clay Yard, the wheel-shed edge and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: the boy is two hundred and twenty-one days old and six months and forty-one days and nobody says so (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth is unpaid for two hundred and twenty-one days (T088); three counts in three places do not become one (T061/T082). First smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that; first sound the kiln in fours with a gap, no bell and no market. The first Account-day of Grain is two mornings behind and the second, Grain 20 (Day 229), is eight mornings ahead; neither is brought early. The district's changed arithmetic goes on unread under this roof: printed one in twelve unchallenged, figure read not figure paid, true subtraction in the locked box up the road, Hessa's slate gone up unread, soft-cuffed clerk at the landing for his uncalled measure, all held offstage and none reached back (T015/T041/T047, T077, T080, T090 held). The seventh green and the seventh shape remain a colour and a shape gathered two days ago, with no eighth, no joining, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale (T050/T051, T033/T034 held advanced). A wrong-wind voice over the boards again lets one of the three shapings of the pot saying stand --- a pot gone quiet on every row come the thaw --- and the boy takes it apart as a surgeon takes apart a wound and leaves it a saying about a pot with no pot lost, no fourth likeness made a cause and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T061/T082, T064). Cost-questions go to the pot and the weather and arrive nowhere, nothing priced, refused or entered (T077). The yard goes around the clean dark line, the new finer grey called thaw, the rack space and broken birth-slates, the pan's gone round ring, the bare dark trough and the field's empty place with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092/T098). Sella's instruction grammar, the house, half-pace, jar-glance and hand half-shut, lips along the two-gapped row, finger above the charcoal, pot handle two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched, no opening in forty-one days (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, six counted where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, the ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 12, warm stone cold in its loft pot; he agrees with the early thaw and the late and keeps wanting the late because it puts off the paying (T036/T076, T006, T062). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust worked past the bent finger, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray, speaks to the wheel and tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the note; the burned-slate word stays a fourth direction arrived nowhere and the two shut-room tellings stay two with no third; his bent finger stands in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Morning hand: up an inch toward the note, down at once against the fold under conditions that had sometimes answered --- an honest miss and no failure hidden under it, filed on the sixth place, no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: What the Tenth Took
scenes.synopsis: Sixth entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 221, Grain 12, Secondday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. The afternoon thins without ending; heat settles into the low places under the shelf, behind the pot and into the fold where one stiff brown-edged crust lies two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third coming; the thread of drool is frozen and unwiped and cold has stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform. Sella stands with her back to the basket, moves her lips along a row standing with two unnamed gaps and gives nobody a figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing without a touch, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, uncounted and uncopied, tells the fire it was the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, stands with the back of the pot in her hand counting under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale, sets the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and lets her hand rest a half-beat longer at the setting, and does not look toward the bed; the widow's mark hangs where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Ember 1 and at no hour since --- no opening in forty-one days --- and the private roll stays unshown and Dessa's cost unentered (T058/T079, T100). Garl is kept to the day without a story: coat, hollow seat, two unswept lines, proverb gone to the pot, tile debt neither paid nor settled nor named, no lesson, no collector, name unspoken for two hundred and twenty-one days (T009/T013/T092). At the kindling Tarn tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, knife at the edge, ear-sentence short of the calling word as a remembered stopping, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent, loan uncalled, no collector on Grain 12, stroke past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector's road without a turn, stone cold in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). Jorra with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, pot told *You'll do*; three shapings of the pot saying stand as sayings about a pot with no lesson made and no name for what ailed the carried man; the burned-slate word a fourth direction arrived nowhere, the two shut-room tellings still two, bent finger in the damper until Sella's sentence reaches the pot as a remembered repetition; *he's not Vail* sealed, promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). Carry home at the going of the light at the half-pace, woodsmoke before in long low bars, river wind behind with the taste of water over water, wide around the pan's gone ring, bare trough, rack space with broken birth-slates, field's empty place and carriers' place, each with a look and a wide step and no number; carrying arm remembers weight and not cost; bed, not loft; fold right, thread frozen (T058/T079, T098). Small hours: the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing --- six hearings with the sixth from a person and no seventh, three near-full answers with three shapings of the pot saying advanced and unpaid, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Ember's three readings and the true subtraction in the locked box, nine stoppings with no payer, three held changes on three places with loft scrape fourth, pale line fifth and held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape on places that do not touch, the burned-slate word on its own place with a hand between the three; no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, nothing filled to make a row come out even (T061/T082, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076, T035/T031). The hand is asked: up an inch toward the note and, with Sella gone to her bed and the two rooms not touching, taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting go of one of the breaths she counts at her fire, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river's next low note --- the two-rhythm coordination remembered, not a longer reach, a miss, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, filed on its sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082). He still cannot close two inches to the pot handle, lift his chin to the crust or speak a number. Two hundred and twenty-one stands exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath; fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and twenty-one days; seventh year at its very end and ungiven; the seventh green and the seventh shape gathered and still unjoined; Grain 20 (Day 229) held eight mornings off as the second Account-day and market. The fire goes on in the room that warms him and the river in the room he cannot enter, and neither stops for the ear under the roof; the count goes forward exact and unspent into Day 222, Grain 13, Firstday, and nothing is settled and nothing is ended. Forward into Chapter 57.
